description_en: Appends structured data rows to a specified dataset without requiring the client to construct SQL statements
description_zh: 向指定 Dataset 追加结构化数据行，避免客户端拼接 SQL
kebab_example: aliyun agentloop add-dataset-data --agent-space sop-agent --dataset-name product_faq_dataset --data-array '[{"content":"hello"}]' --client-token a1b2c3d4-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDatasetData

parameters.description_en: The array of data rows to append. The array cannot be empty. The server reads the data in streaming mode. The maximum request body size is 100 MB by default. All rows in a single request are committed in an all-or-nothing transaction.
